assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-width editorial illustration embedded in a Vietnamese literary vault article.
Style/medium: richly detailed hand-painted Chinese historical narrative illustration, ink and gouache on gently textured parchment, fine expressive brushwork, believable human anatomy and physical spaces, evocative mature literary atmosphere. Fictional Three Kingdoms era, ordinary people portrayed with dignity.
Composition/framing: cinematic wide landscape, 3:2 aspect ratio, full bleed. Distinct subjects and readable storytelling at article width.
Color palette: muted jade green, ochre earth, charcoal gray, warm amber highlights, restrained saturation.
Constraints: entirely fictional ancient setting, no present-day people, no modern vehicles or structures, no real-world brand, no logos, no lettering, no captions, no visible words, no watermark. Let metaphor emerge naturally from the scene rather than literal arrows, charts or diagrams.
Primary request: A cinematic elevated view from a humble horse-cart driver's small dusty courtyard toward an immense planned coastal city construction project. The immediate foreground shows a carefully maintained wooden cart and a driver in simple worn robes, seen in profile contemplating the vista. Beyond his low wall, a road leads through a wealthy estate gate and branches naturally into a market street, rows of newly built housing, and active transport yards. Farther away stand extensive stone quays and newly reclaimed earthen embankments along the sea, scaffolded walls, human builders carrying materials, and many small working transport carts. The enormous development visibly dwarfs the home. The sea remains visible so this is clearly a coastal land-making project, all using plausible ancient stone, timber, earthworks and cranes.
Lighting/mood: hazy late-afternoon amber sun over cool jade water, awe tinged with unease; interdependence between transport, land and property obligations; human-scale foreground and expansive background.
Avoid: literal chessboards, gold coins falling from the sky, caricature, dystopian exaggeration, giant developer character, recognizable political figures.
assets.quality_notes: Verified coherent ancient scene, readable storytelling, no modern company references or lettering, consistent palette and 3:2 composition.

Primary request: An intimate evening scene inside a modest ancient family's home. A tired but dignified horse-cart driver has just returned and is settling beside an elderly parent and a school-age child at a low worn wooden table. The child has a brush, blank study papers and simple wooden counting rods beside a small bowl. A simple shared meal of rice, vegetables and broth rests on the table; a tiny modest pile of ancient round coins with square holes lies beside the driver's weathered hand, naturally part of the domestic scene. The elder pours tea with care. Show their quiet attention to one another, warmth and uncertainty together. Through the open doorway in the far background, distant ceremonial lanterns glow along a prosperous street; a small glimpse of a parked wooden cart and resting horse is visible outside. The ceremonial lights are small and peripheral so the family remains the emotional focus.
Lighting/mood: soft warm amber lamplight on faces and hands, jade dusk through doorway, gentle intimacy, trust and well-being measured in daily life beyond public applause.
Avoid: extreme destitution, tears, melodramatic suffering, politician or ruler, modern utensils, writing or calligraphy, decorative banner text.
